scripts.deps:check: madge --circular --extensions ts,tsx --ts-config packages/config/tsconfig.base.json packages apps/web/app apps/web/worker
scripts.deploy:dev: pnpm --filter @pm/web exec sh -c "CLOUDFLARE_ENV=dev react-router build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.jsonc --env dev && wrangler deploy"
scripts.deploy:staging: pnpm --filter @pm/web exec sh -c "CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging react-router build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.jsonc --env staging && wrangler deploy"
scripts.deploy:production: pnpm --filter @pm/web exec sh -c "CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production react-router build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.jsonc --env production && wrangler deploy"
